Zur, also called Strapack, is a fungus of cold underground environments in central Endor. It is moderately difficult to find in suitable places.

Prepared as an infusion or decoction, it roughly triples the effective range of smell and hearing and grants about +50 to Perception rolls based on those two senses for one hour. The catalogue records a risk of habituation with repeated doses.
